def factor_range_reversal_continuous_vol_weighted(df):
    """Range expansion reversal with continuous volume weight: positive signal on wide-range drops, weighted by relative volume intensity without a floor."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    range_mean = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    range_std = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    range_z = (range_ - range_mean) / range_std.replace(0, np.nan)
    ret5 = df_copy["close"] / df_copy["close"].shift(5) - 1
    raw_signal = -ret5 * range_z
    avg_vol = df_copy["volume"].rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_ratio = df_copy["volume"] / avg_vol.replace(0, np.nan)
    vol_weight = np.clip(vol_ratio, 0.0, 2.0) / 2.0
    signal = raw_signal * vol_weight
    signal = signal.ewm(span=3, min_periods=3).mean()
    df_copy["factor_range_reversal_continuous_vol_weighted"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_range_reversal_continuous_vol_weighted"]
description: Simplifies the volume weighting to a continuous [0,1] range without a floor, enhancing signal differentiation across volume levels. Preserves ICIR and RankICIR stability of the parent's stable reversal mechanism while potentially improving signal continuity and coverage.
